items.title: Live: Shadow treasurer indicates Coalition support for new WA oil refinery
items.description: Shadow Treasurer Tim Wilson indicates the Coalition will support the construction of a new oil refinery in Western Australia. Follow live.

items.title: Jacinta Allan expected to lose leadership as showdown looms
items.description: Victorian Premier Jacinta Allan will face a leadership challenge at a meeting of Labor MPs this morning after Deputy Premier Ben Carroll said he would run for the top job.

items.title: Australia should brace for war impact to get worse, Treasury warns
items.description: The federal government is yet to reveal whether it will extend the fuel excise discount, which is set to expire this week.

items.title: How an accident changed the path of a grieving Angus Taylor's life
items.description: The Liberal leader opens about a balcony fall that left him with a broken back and altered the course of his life.

items.title: Salmon farming transformed Norway. Now it's facing the consequences
items.description: Norway's salmon industry is a global behemoth 18 times the size of Tasmania's. But the country's success holds a warning for Australia.

items.title: Trump tips the balance towards China in trade war
items.description: China has the market sewn up in everything from solar panels to battery manufacturing and wind turbines. And now it is challenging America's commanding role in technology.

items.title: Warnings consumers 'the fall guy' if data centres soak up spare power supply
items.description: Consumers should brace for hefty increases in the cost of generating electricity as data centres suck up vast quantities of power faster than new plants can be built, experts say.

items.title: Secret documents show 'horrifying' traces of horse meat in food
items.description: Government documents show hundreds of businesses operating in Australia have breached food safety laws, with one politician warning "you could be eating a minced horse".

items.title: Science and politics collide in fraught puberty blockers debate
items.description: The fierce debate over puberty blockers has become a collision of science and politics. To try to address a fractured consensus, the federal government is attempting to lay the groundwork for a national standard.

items.title: Live: Australia claims first athletics gold, Dolphins dominating once more
items.description: Australia is enjoying another wildly successful day at the Commonwealth Games, with Rose Davies claiming her nation's first athletics gold and the Dolphins sweeping the medals in two events in the pool.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
